audit_type: Independent recomputation from saved native detections and separately stored author-derived annotations; no model inference.

boundary_rules.confidence_order: descending; stable original order for ties
boundary_rules.full_observation: Inference ROI covers the entire polygon including boundaries; None means full image.
boundary_rules.occupancy_denominator: All manifest spots, including partially and fully unobserved spots.

limitations: This audit verifies cached scoring and integrity, not whether annotation labels are perfect or model inference is scientifically generalizable.
